name: EU Enabler
subtitle: Enable EU/Japan Marketplace apps on iOS.

apps.name: EU Enabler
apps.subtitle: This is the regular release build of the EU Enabler.
apps.localizedDescription:
Enables installing EU/Japan Marketplace apps by overriding App Store eligibility and spoofing the device region. Built on the DarkSword exploit. Supports iOS 16.0 - iOS 18.7.1 & iOS 26.0.x, excluding M5 and A19.
For more information, check out our GitHub! https://github.com/TheDuckMan64/lara.
